title: Slime grass, nylium and tall grass on PlutoLib behaviours
goal: Port SlimeGrassBlock, SlimeNyliumBlock, SlimeTallGrassBlock, SlimeRootsBlock and SlimeGrassSeedItem from the original Java into tconstruct/mixins/tconstruct/api/src/world.rs (a new function register_grass called from lib.rs next to register_leaves) using only the PlutoLib behaviour API (random_tick, bonemeal, may_place_on, can_survive, BlockEditor). Then delete the old direct injections and modules that these classes replace.
verify: cargo test --locked --manifest-path pluto-lib/tests/pure/Cargo.toml (only if PlutoLib files are untouched; they must be)
stop_and_report_if: a PlutoLib behaviour API call you need does not exist
the Java needs world generation (a tree or feature placement): leave that class partial and say what is missing
a manifest id above is used by another module you were not told about
notes: Each removed injection also removes its helper .rs file, its [[module]] if only it used it, and its id from known_overlaps in tools/injection_limits.json (and lowers max by the number of injections removed; this file is the one tools/ file you may edit, only those two fields). Keep the property names the content blocks already use (see tconstruct/content/data/tconstruct/horizon/block/).
